consistency: One authoritative instance per backend. Committed seed/live rows must be visible to new autocommit reads. No replica/HA claim.
atomicity: Single INSERT acknowledgements only. General COPY error atomicity, multi-key transactions and snapshot-isolation anomalies are not qualified.
cedar_durability: Every Go connection sets and reads back async_commit=off. Native backup requires v2026-11-18. Process SIGKILL is tested separately from physical power loss.
postgres_durability: Every Go connection sets and reads back synchronous_commit=on. Server fsync and full_page_writes remain enabled.
restore: Require all seed rows and every ACK witnessed before backup invocation. Reconcile later ACKs separately as measured snapshot RPO. Restore a clone on new owned storage; never mutate the backup archive.

reference_client.arrival: ticker-paced closed loop, dropped ticks under backpressure
reference_client.tls: disabled on private lab network, not a production security configuration

data.columns: id I64 PK, customer I32, amount I32, payload TEXT NOT NULL
data.shape: 192 bytes repeated customer prefix plus 64 ASCII SHA256 hex characters; deterministic order:<id>, no nulls
data.live_ids: Exclusive million-ID range per history, never reused

witness: Intent and outcome JSONL fsynced per operation outside database volumes. Failed/submitted outcomes remain ambiguous; reconnect never replays a mutation.
limits: Single Docker host, no independent-host or power-loss proof. Fixed offered-load operational observations, not a capacity benchmark. No disk loss, corruption, partitions, pressure, upgrade or multi-node qualification yet. CedarDB engine source is not publicly available; inspect shipped entrypoint, versioned public APIs and the pinned pgx source instead.
